title: The vector store is down and the error has a name
goal: For {{castBrand}}, {{castApp}} keeps calling {{castKey}} while the key's vector Redis is unavailable.
obstacle: A blank page or a silent failure would hide the outage from {{castOwner}}.
control: The lab returns a named error, makes no model call and counts no Usage. What the product does in an outage is UNVERIFIED: the lab claims neither that it fails open nor that it fails closed.
